snippet.title: Dreamcards - Announcement Trailer (EN)
snippet.description:
A roguelike deckbuilder that mixes occultism, psychology and strategy. Spend a week in the life of “Self”, manipulating your deck during the day and facing your monster within during the night. Gather consciousness points to reach a lucid dream state and escape from the nightmare.

Wishlist now on Steam
